recon.label: Recon quadcopter
recon.deciding: RF shows a 2.4 GHz control link, and it creeps in slowly, then hovers to watch

fpv.label: FPV attack drone
fpv.deciding: RF shows a 5.8 GHz video link, and it flies fast, low and weaving

acoustic.sig: Racing-quad scream, rising and falling with throttle

loiter.label: Loitering munition
loiter.deciding: RF shows no emission, it flies fast and straight in, and the camera shows a wing

acoustic.sig: Small propeller buzz, steady and unchanging

swarm.label: Swarm drone
swarm.deciding: several small echoes moved together in formation

acoustic.sig: Layered hum of many small rotors

friendly.label: Friendly UAV
friendly.deciding: the friendly check matched a flight plan

bird.label: Bird / clutter
bird.deciding: erratic path, tiny echo, no radio emission

acoustic.sig: No motor sound; wing beats and calls only

fibre.label: Fibre-optic FPV
fibre.behaviour: Fast, low, weaving, yet silent on RF
fibre.deciding: it flies like an FPV (fast, low, weaving) but RF shows no emission: it is steered down a fibre-optic cable, so jamming and spoofing cannot touch it

acoustic.sig: Racing-quad scream, but no radio heard

aiStrike.label: AI-guided attack drone
aiStrike.behaviour: Low and straight in, on its own
aiStrike.deciding: no emission and a small fixed wing flying low and straight in: it guides itself by camera, with no radio and no GNSS, so only hard-kill works

jetOwa.label: Jet one-way attack drone
jetOwa.behaviour: Very fast, straight at the asset
jetOwa.deciding: no emission, a fixed wing, and about twice as fast as a propeller loitering munition: a jet one-way attack drone, GNSS-guided

dropper.label: Payload-drop drone
dropper.behaviour: Slow and heavy, heading straight for the asset
dropper.deciding: a 2.4 GHz control link like a recon quad, but a bigger echo and it does not stop to watch: a heavy multirotor carrying a payload to drop on the asset

vtol.label: Hybrid VTOL ISR drone
vtol.behaviourHover: Switched to rotors, hovering to watch
vtol.deciding: a fixed wing on a 1.4 GHz control link that flew in, then stopped and hovered: a hybrid VTOL surveillance drone

acoustic.sig: Rotor hum on the hover, pusher-prop drone in forward flight

tacIsr.label: Tactical ISR fixed-wing
tacIsr.behaviourHover: Circling at a distance, spotting for artillery
tacIsr.deciding: a small fixed wing on an 868–900 MHz control link that circles at a distance with no flight plan (the friendly check fails): an enemy artillery spotter

acoustic.sig: Small piston engine, like a moped

male.label: Large military UAV (MALE)
male.behaviourHover: Circling high at standoff range, watching the asset
male.deciding: a large radar echo, high up, on a datalink, circling at standoff range: a medium-altitude long-endurance (MALE) military UAV

acoustic.sig: Faint, distant engine drone from high altitude

civil.label: Civil drone (registered)
civil.behaviour: Drifting about, not heading for the asset
civil.deciding: a registered 2.4 GHz link and an aimless path that never closes on the asset: a civil drone; report it and keep watching, never engage
